subject.title: fix(media): normalize case-insensitive file:// URI schemes in MEDIA directives (#103473)

question: After the spaced-path regression and proof gap are resolved, should maintainers adopt this narrow parser PR or the broader sibling that also changes independently reachable media resolvers?
rationale: Three overlapping branches exist, and selecting parser-only scope versus broader normalization of separate media APIs requires ownership judgment rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Repair This Narrow PR
options.body: Make the parser fallback use the same case-insensitive scheme predicate, add spaced-path coverage, obtain outbound proof, and close the redundant candidates.

options.title: Adopt The Broader Sibling
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103539 only after its additional resolver changes receive direct contract tests and proof.

options.title: Request One Replacement
options.body: Pause all three candidates and request one fresh proof-positive parser-scoped PR.

recommendation.title: Repair This Narrow PR
recommendation.body: Make the parser fallback use the same case-insensitive scheme predicate, add spaced-path coverage, obtain outbound proof, and close the redundant candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and substantially evolved both the MEDIA parser and its space-preserving fallback.
